tasks.short: Name the risks and sign the strategy

steps.what: Open environmental constraints on civil engineering projects
Identify environmental risks from the site
Develop management strategies citing the named risks

loop.input: Risk ids the civil engineer named on the site.
loop.output: A strategy draft that cites only those risk ids.
loop.check: Every risk id in the draft was named by the civil engineer.
loop.stop: Stop when a risk id is missing. The civil engineer writes that part.
loop.why_not_simpler: A fixed list cannot write the strategy sentences, and a draft that adds a risk is not acceptable.

tasks.design: Environmental constraints on civil engineering projects are opened from {DOCS}. The civil engineer identifies environmental risks from the site. A draft develops management strategies that cite only the risks the engineer named, and it stops when a risk id is missing. The civil engineer signs the strategy. The screen does not rank a risk as acceptable.
tasks.previous_blocker: The strategy was written after a site walk with no shared risk list.
tasks.enabler_now: The constraint file is already stored.
tasks.still_hard: Naming the risks stays with the civil engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The civil engineer sees the site and decides which risks matter.

ambition.what: A strategy can be signed only when it cites risks the engineer named.

tasks.altitude: The week still includes the site walk and the signature. The draft cites only named risks.

reach.learn: Which risk ids the strategy cites.

evidence.claim: A draft can cite risk ids the civil engineer named. The engineer still identifies the risks and signs the strategy. A stored project row can show the file id, the figure id, and the text a person already entered. The civil engineer still decides the specification, the design, and the site work. A blank input stays blank.

The source pack names a rule that a safety component for road traffic, water, gas, heating, or electricity is high-risk, and that an automated safety function on machinery comes into scope on a stated date. A solely automated decision about a worker is barred, and a study of presence, behaviour, or performance needs consent where a works council has that right. The signing engineer stays responsible. This work does not score staff and does not set a safety specification. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when environmental constraints are stored and ends when the engineer has signed the strategy or stopped on a missing risk id.
A constraint row has constraint id and text, entered by the project lead. A risk id is created only when the civil engineer names it.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the civil engineer's effort.
A missing figure, price, file id, or criterion id is not invented. The civil engineer does that part.
The incremental hour updates the opened file when its source row changes.
unknowns: How often the site shows a risk that is not in the constraint file.
research_questions: Which strategies were signed, and which stopped because a risk id was missing?

already_counted.description: Reading the opened file is already in the civil engineer's step.

incremental.description: Update the opened file when its source row changes.

approvals.approved_version: The strategy and the risk ids the engineer named

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the site shows a risk with no id and the engineer writes the strategy. High: the constraints are open and the engineer still names the risks and signs. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Study traffic or conditions and assess impact

steps.what: Open prior traffic and environmental studies
Conduct studies of traffic patterns or environmental conditions
Identify engineering problems and assess potential project impact

tasks.design: Prior traffic and environmental studies are opened from {DOCS}. The civil engineer conducts studies of traffic patterns or environmental conditions, then identifies engineering problems and assesses potential project impact. The studies stay with the engineer. The screen does not assess the impact.
tasks.previous_blocker: Prior studies were a folder the engineer read before going out.
tasks.enabler_now: The prior studies are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The studies and the impact call stay with the civil engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The civil engineer observes the pattern and judges the impact.
tasks.altitude: The week is still field study. Prior studies are open before the engineer goes out.

evidence.claim: Stored prior studies can be opened. Conducting the studies and assessing impact stay with the civil engineer. A stored project row can show the file id, the figure id, and the text a person already entered. The civil engineer still decides the specification, the design, and the site work. A blank input stays blank.

The source pack names a rule that a safety component for road traffic, water, gas, heating, or electricity is high-risk, and that an automated safety function on machinery comes into scope on a stated date. A solely automated decision about a worker is barred, and a study of presence, behaviour, or performance needs consent where a works council has that right. The signing engineer stays responsible. This work does not score staff and does not set a safety specification. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when prior studies are stored and ends when the engineer has written the impact note or marked the study incomplete.
A study row has study id and kind, entered by the project lead. Kind is traffic patterns or environmental conditions.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the civil engineer's effort.
A missing figure, price, file id, or criterion id is not invented. The civil engineer does that part.
The incremental hour updates the opened file when its source row changes.
unknowns: How often the prior study does not match the site.
research_questions: Which studies were conducted, and which were marked incomplete?

already_counted.description: Reading the opened file is already in the civil engineer's step.

incremental.description: Update the opened file when its source row changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the prior study does not match the site and the engineer starts again. High: the prior study is open and the engineer still conducts the study and assesses impact. The range stays under the net.

tasks.short: Sign the cleanup before the site work

steps.what: Open industrial accidents and other contaminated sites
Develop engineering solutions to clean the site
Implement the solution on the site

tasks.design: Industrial accidents and other contaminated sites are opened from {PROJECT}. The file is the site record, not a worker health record. The civil engineer develops engineering solutions to clean the site and signs them before implementation. The screen does not choose the method. Implementation stays on the site.
tasks.previous_blocker: The site file and the solution lived in separate notes.
tasks.enabler_now: The site file is already stored.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing how to clean the site, and doing the work, stay with the civil engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The civil engineer is responsible for the solution that is implemented.

ambition.what: A cleanup solution can be signed before implementation starts.

tasks.altitude: The week still includes the site. Implementation starts only from a signed solution.

reach.learn: Which site file the solution cites.

evidence.claim: A stored site file can be opened. Developing and implementing the cleanup stay with the civil engineer. A stored project row can show the file id, the figure id, and the text a person already entered. The civil engineer still decides the specification, the design, and the site work. A blank input stays blank.

The source pack names a rule that a safety component for road traffic, water, gas, heating, or electricity is high-risk, and that an automated safety function on machinery comes into scope on a stated date. A solely automated decision about a worker is barred, and a study of presence, behaviour, or performance needs consent where a works council has that right. The signing engineer stays responsible. This work does not score staff and does not set a safety specification. Other countries differ.
The source pack names an electronic procedure for cross-border waste shipments. This work does not file that procedure, and the civil engineer does not invent one. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when an industrial accident or contaminated site is on the project and ends when the engineer has signed the solution and the site work has started or stopped.
A site row has site id and kind, entered by the project lead. Kind is industrial accident or other contaminated site. The file does not hold a worker health record.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the civil engineer's effort.
A missing figure, price, file id, or criterion id is not invented. The civil engineer does that part.
The incremental hour updates the opened file when its source row changes.
unknowns: How often the site file is too thin to choose a method.
research_questions: Which solutions were signed before implementation, and which site files were too thin?

already_counted.description: Reading the opened file is already in the civil engineer's step.

incremental.description: Update the opened file when its source row changes.

approvals.approved_version: The cleanup solution before it is implemented

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the site file is too thin and the engineer studies the site first. High: the file is open and the engineer still develops, signs, and implements the solution. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design the waste system and sign it

steps.what: Open rules for chemical, biological, and other toxic wastes
Design or engineer systems to dispose of them efficiently

tasks.design: Rules for chemical, biological, and other toxic wastes are opened from {DOCS}. The civil engineer designs or engineers the systems to dispose of them efficiently and signs the design before release. The screen does not design the system. A rule that is not in the file is not treated as met.
tasks.previous_blocker: The waste rules were a folder the engineer read beside the design.
tasks.enabler_now: The rule file is already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The design of the disposal system stays with the civil engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The civil engineer chooses the system and signs it.

ambition.what: A waste design can be released only after the engineer signs it.

tasks.altitude: The week is still design. The rule file is open before the engineer starts.

reach.learn: Which rule file the design cites.

evidence.claim: A stored rule file can be opened. Designing the disposal system stays with the civil engineer. A stored project row can show the file id, the figure id, and the text a person already entered. The civil engineer still decides the specification, the design, and the site work. A blank input stays blank.

The source pack names a rule that a safety component for road traffic, water, gas, heating, or electricity is high-risk, and that an automated safety function on machinery comes into scope on a stated date. A solely automated decision about a worker is barred, and a study of presence, behaviour, or performance needs consent where a works council has that right. The signing engineer stays responsible. This work does not score staff and does not set a safety specification. Other countries differ.
The source pack names an electronic procedure for cross-border waste shipments. This work does not file that procedure, and the civil engineer does not invent one. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when rules for toxic wastes are stored and ends when the engineer has signed the design or returned the rule file as incomplete.
A rule row has rule id and waste kind, entered by the project lead. Kind is chemical, biological, or other toxic waste.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the civil engineer's effort.
A missing figure, price, file id, or criterion id is not invented. The civil engineer does that part.
The incremental hour updates the opened file when its source row changes.
unknowns: How often the rule file does not cover the waste on the project.
research_questions: Which waste designs were signed, and which rule files were incomplete?

incremental.description: Update the opened file when its source row changes.

approvals.approved_version: The waste system design before it is released

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the rule file does not cover the waste and the engineer stops. High: the rules are open and the engineer still designs and signs the system. The range stays under the net.

role.altitude: The civil engineer still names risks, studies the site, and designs the cleanup or the waste system. A constraint file is open first.
reach: The project file shows a strategy only after the engineer signs it.
Implementation starts only from a signed cleanup note.
skills_to_grow: Do not rank a risk as acceptable from a file.
Do not start a cleanup from a figure.
Do not release a waste design the engineer did not sign.
role.ambitious_version: Constraints and site records are open before the strategy or the design. The engineer still names the risks, runs the studies, and signs the cleanup or the waste system.
